Rank the best candidate DAGs by likelihood of matching all observations. A node reaches exactly the nodes marked 1 along directed paths. Avoid cycles. Return 4 distinct IDs in priority order.
Observations:
Perturb(A) -> A:0 B:1 C:1 D:1 E:0 F:1
Perturb(B) -> A:0 B:0 C:1 D:1 E:0 F:0
Perturb(D) -> A:0 B:0 C:0 D:0 E:0 F:0
Perturb(E) -> A:1 B:1 C:1 D:1 E:0 F:1
Candidates:
1. Graph: A->B, A->C, A->F, B->C, B->D, E->A
2. Graph: A->B, A->D, A->F, B->C, B->D, E->A
3. Graph: A->B, A->F, B->C, B->D
4. Graph: A->B, A->F, B->C, B->D, C->D, E->A
5. Graph: A->B, A->F, B->C, B->D, E->A, E->B
6. Graph: A->B, A->F, B->C, E->A
7. Graph: A->B, A->F, B->D, E->A
8. Graph: A->B, B->C, B->D, E->A
